title: Dr. Ágnes Balassa
seoTitle: Dr. Ágnes Balassa – Founding partner, attorney at law
description: Dr. Ágnes Balassa. Founding partner, attorney at law. Professional background and contact information at Bihary Balassa in Budapest.

content.text: Partner, founding member, attorney at law. Graduated from Eötvös Loránd University Budapest in 1992. Worked for Eörsi & Partners Attorneys at Law between 1992-1999. Bar Examination in 1999. Partner of Sándor, Bihary, Szegedi, Szent-Ivány Attorneys at Law between 1999 and 2002.
Specialized fields: corporate and commercial law, project finance and real property law. Near-native German, fluent English.
